interpretation: The frozen hypothesis requires complete UTC daily bars. A final nine-hour exchange session is not an eligible complete day and must not become a feature or return observation. Rejecting the entire otherwise checksum-valid archive was stricter than the frozen complete-day contract and would convert an execution-session boundary into a source-family failure.

correction.rule: Exclude a row only when its open is exactly UTC midnight, its close is after open but before the full 24-hour close, and it is the final row of that monthly archive. Record every excluded identity and duration in the sealed corpus ledger.
correction.fail_closed: Reject every partial row that is not the final archive row, starts off the UTC daily lattice, has a nonpositive duration, exceeds 24 hours, or leaves an archive with no complete rows.
correction.outcome_independence: The correction depends only on open timestamp, close timestamp and row position. No OHLC price, quote volume, return, rank, strategy path, PnL, drawdown or post-2024 evidence was inspected or used.

prohibited_changes: Do not interpolate or rescale the partial session.
Do not convert it into a complete day.
Do not change cohort month, archive window, asset taxonomy, momentum horizon, liquidity rule, parent, costs or gates.
Do not retain the failed partial row in either the candidate or parent corpus.
scope_note: No sealed corpus output, strategy outcome, candidate, OOS, paid API, second timer, second writer, canonical write, Production, Trading, database, order, fund, OCO, Grid, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE action occurred.
